image_prompt.text: The circular arena platform's edges drop straight away into open sky on every side of the floating island, so aggressive positioning risks a ring-out into nothing
Ancient ruined stone pillars and partially broken arches standing along one side of the platform, tall enough to break the boss's line of sight on a player backing off
A small compact floating island of dark earth and stone, about 40-50 studs across, with a flat top and an underside that tapers down into jagged rocky points
A circular flat stone arena platform on the island's top, its surface carved with ancient cracked runes, left clear enough for a 1v1 boss fight to move around in
Several glowing magical crystals in purple and cyan jutting out at angles around the rim of the arena platform, lighting the dark stone with an enchanted, ominous glow
Small rocks floating in a slow orbit around the main island

layout_placement.text: The point on the arena platform where the boss enters for the 1v1 fight

notes: Boss Raid preset taken on its own shape, arena-flat, which the prompt already describes: a flat circular fighting platform. hazard-kill and spawner-npc kept.

Preset caveat: destructible-cluster dropped. Nothing in the prompt is breakable - the pillars and arches are described as already ruined static geometry - and fracturing cover would eat the open duelling space the prompt explicitly asks for.
cover-los added on top of the preset for the ruined pillars and arches the prompt describes; the preset did not carry it.
Island size stated as 40-50 studs across and the platform as circular; carried in the text rather than count, since count holds a single stated number and this is a range.

Request no option covers: exposed, tweakable attributes for crystal colour, crystal glow intensity, island size, and platform diameter. That is a Studio authoring concern rather than layout geometry, so nothing in the handoff can carry it.

would have asked: Sounds like a boss-fight arena: one flat circular fighting floor with runes carved into it, open edges you can be knocked off, and a point where the boss enters - plus the broken pillars and arches you described along one side. Standard single-pass build, nothing slow about it. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: The prompt already answers shape (flat circular platform) and the ring-out edges, so the only Core option left to confirm is spawn-protected - whether the player's own spawn should be set back or screened. Judged unnecessary for a 1v1 arena with no respawn described, and left out.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
